scope: Strategy step 6 selected production coexistence, latency, lifetime and ownership gate; supported delivery/release remains step 7

resident_provider_allowances.basis: Reserved planning caps for step 3; remeasure and redesign before exceeding either cap

local_preview.scope: Existing launchers forward to the measured preview; private D8 settings reuse the existing writable disk through a symlink. No GUI emulator was launched.

native_refresh.focused_fixture_scope: Retained matched QED-source/C-ABI rendering and lifetime fixtures use their recorded native providers. The refreshed desktop selector and transport are exercised by all three new normal-package cohorts.

preceding_attempts.scope: The refreshed selector completed the Counter workflow. These baseline/Counter attempts then failed report finalization because the observer omitted boot-smoke.png. The checksum attempt failed navigation at 1002.8 ms. The current observer saves the required scanout; patch 0026 paints content before caption RPCs. None of these preceding attempts counts as a passing cohort.

lifetime.private_stats_scope: QED allocator payload plus its headers, before native heap rounding; actual rounded system occupancy is covered by native free extents.
lifetime.stack_scope: Selected PCs in the first large-document lifetime only; guards and functional collection in all four. Actual captured APP image bases and native/provider sites; per-pool Process ordinals, DP and guards remain checked. Broad candidate-only sites are excluded. Selected-PC observations, not a watermark.

stop_dispatch: Owning shell EXECUTE reads 65,544-byte STOP.CMD, then resolves a temporary alias to ordinary BREAK; QED is focused before the decision opens; alias removed after Cancel.

bank_zero_delta.basis: Refreshed desktop selector; complete measured bank-zero budget equals the interactive cursor preview, including every Task/DP/stack/guard/alignment/slack reservation

limits: Pinned ROM/emulator and 8x PAL configuration; sampled response and backing, first-lifetime selected stack tracing plus all-lifetime guards. No worst-case or hosted/release qualification claim.
